race.title: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60)
race.verdict: RED GLORY is on a fair mark on the level judged on his Thurles second and is worth another chance with the step up to 2m likely to suit. Friday's winner Young Churchill can go well again if staying the longer trip, with Duke Otto another to consider after his recent hurdles victory. RED GLORY (IRE) YOUNG CHURCHILL (IRE) DUKE OTTO (IRE)
